# 2ND ADDENDUM TO THE BIDDING DOCUMENT FOR PROVISION OF SUPPORT & MAINTENANCE OF ENTERPRISE RESOURCE PLANNING SYSTEM (ERP)
URA/ITID/NCONS/25-26/01607
Reference is made to the advert for the 1 st addendum that appeared on 3 rd February 2026 in the Daily Monitor newspaper for extension of bid closing date from Friday 30 th January 2026 to 27 th February 2026.
This is to inform all interested bidders that the bid closing date has been further extended from Friday 27 th February 2026 to Friday 13 th March 2026 as per the revised procurement schedule below;
The New Planned procurement schedule is as follows;
Activity
Publish bid notice
30 th December 2025
Pre-bid meeting
20 th January 2026 at 10:00am
Bid closing date
13 th March 2026 at 10:00am
Bid opening date
13 th March 2026 at 10:30am
Evaluation process
16 th to 31 st March 2026
Display and communication of shortlisted bidders
6 th to 17 th April 2026
Date of Contract Signing
After Solicitor General’s Clearance
Any queries should be addressed to;
The Assistant Commissioner, Procurement & Disposal Division,
Uganda Revenue Authority Headquarters,
Plot M193/M194, Nakawa Industrial Area,
13 th Floor URA Tower,
P.O. Box 7279, Kampala.
Telephone: 256 (0) 417- 442155/6/7/8/9
The detailed bid notice is available at the Entity’s website at www.ura.go.ug and at www.ppda.go.ug
ACCOUNTING OFFICER
